subject: Scheduling: cross-region product walkthrough and time-zone clarifications
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@greenpathhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: Redwood demo — good time windows for our execs

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the patience while we pulled calendars. We'd like a focused 45‑minute walkthrough of Redwood (inference performance, security controls, and deployment options) with a few execs and our infra lead. Our preferred windows next week are: 

- Tue, Nov 2 — 09:00–09:45 PDT
- Wed, Nov 3 — 11:00–11:45 PDT (backup)

We are on US West coast time (PDT) in the invite text. Can you confirm who from Redwood will join and whether those times work for your EU engineering folks?

Also — if there are DST complications around Nov 1, please call out the UTC times so we can be explicit in the invite.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Director of Product, GreenPath Health
olivia@greenpathhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@greenpathhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T12:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — good time windows for our execs

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the slots, and great question about DST. Quick answers up front:

- We can join Tue Nov 2.
- To avoid ambiguity, good to lock by UTC: Tue Nov 2 16:00–16:45 UTC corresponds to Tue Nov 2 09:00 PDT (US West) and Tue Nov 2 17:00 CET (central Europe) because EU clocks fall back on Oct 31 (CEST -> CET).

A couple of notes on the DST quirk: Europe moves back on Oct 31 this year, while the US stays on DST until Nov 7. That means the usual 6‑hour difference temporarily becomes 5 hours for the week after Oct 31; we mention UTC above to be explicit.

Who from our side: Jonas (solutions engineering) will lead the demo and I will join for the commercial/context questions. Irene (copied) will bring the deck and a short pre‑recorded deep dive on the Dedicated routing behavior so we don’t keep your infra lead up late.

We can either run the full 45‑minute live slot at 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PDT, or split into a 25‑minute live demo + 20‑minute recorded walkthrough + Q&A if that helps your team's schedule. Which would you prefer?

Irene — can you attach the short deck and a recorded walk‑through stub?

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com

Attaching a short deck (redwood-demo-deck.pdf) and a 12‑minute recording stub we use for pre‑reads. If you go for the split format, we’ll send the recording the day before so your infra lead can review asynchronously; live time can focus on questions and the production runbook.

Attachment stubs included: 1) redwood-demo-deck.pdf (16 slides) 2) redwood-dedicated-routing-recording.mp4 (12m stub)

Best,
